scientific.integrity: The YellowFin robust interval is converted to an exact interval for the scalar momentum-matrix trace parameter. A two-step product calculation and the complete second-order Jury criterion yield a necessary-and-sufficient uniform two-period threshold, attained by opposite robust-region endpoints.
limitations: The switched signal is an abstract time-varying quadratic model.
No statement about arbitrary switching periods, stochastic tuning, clipping, or asynchronous feedback.
The theorem sharpens the source's explicit composition caveat rather than contradicting its one-step lemma.

title: YellowFin's robust region has a sharp switching-instability threshold
